app_title: Dark Pattern Detection: Semantic–Linguistic Feature Fusion

feature_definitions.length_char: Total character count of the sanitized text string.
feature_definitions.length_token: Total token count parsed by spaCy.
feature_definitions.uppercase_ratio: Proportion of uppercase letters among alphabetic characters.
feature_definitions.exclamation_count: Count of exclamation mark punctuation characters.
feature_definitions.question_count: Count of question mark punctuation characters.
feature_definitions.pos_prop_VERB: Proportion of tokens tagged as VERB (action/process verbs).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_NOUN: Proportion of tokens tagged as NOUN (common nouns).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_ADJ: Proportion of tokens tagged as ADJ (qualitative adjectives).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_ADV: Proportion of tokens tagged as ADV (adverbial modifiers).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_PRON: Proportion of tokens tagged as PRON (personal/relative pronouns).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_NUM: Proportion of tokens tagged as NUM (cardinal numbers).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_AUX: Proportion of tokens tagged as AUX (auxiliary and modal verbs).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_CCONJ: Proportion of coordinating conjunctions (and, but, or).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_SCONJ: Proportion of subordinating conjunctions (if, because, while).
feature_definitions.pos_prop_DET: Proportion of determiners (the, a, this, that).
feature_definitions.dep_prop_nsubj: Proportion of nominal subject dependency relations.
feature_definitions.dep_prop_dobj: Proportion of direct object dependency relations.
feature_definitions.dep_prop_advmod: Proportion of adverbial modifier dependency relations.
feature_definitions.dep_prop_amod: Proportion of adjectival modifier dependency relations.
feature_definitions.dep_prop_prep: Proportion of prepositional modifier dependency relations.
feature_definitions.max_tree_depth: Maximum dependency tree depth representing syntactic embedding complexity.
feature_definitions.is_imperative: Binary indicator for directive/imperative clause (base verb root without explicit subject).
feature_definitions.is_verb_initial: Binary indicator for sentence starting with a verb or auxiliary.
feature_definitions.modal_count: Count of modal auxiliary verbs (can, could, will, would, must, should, may, might).
feature_definitions.modal_prop: Proportion of modal auxiliary verbs relative to token count.
feature_definitions.negation_count: Count of negation dependency tokens (neg) or negative particles (no, not, never).
feature_definitions.has_negation: Binary indicator for the presence of negation.
feature_definitions.pron_1p_count: Count of 1st-person pronouns (I, me, my, we, us, our).
feature_definitions.pron_2p_count: Count of 2nd-person directive pronouns (you, your, yours).
feature_definitions.pron_3p_count: Count of 3rd-person pronouns (he, she, it, they, them, their).
feature_definitions.time_expression_count: Frequency of temporal interval markers (seconds, minutes, hours, days, now, soon, today).
feature_definitions.has_time_expression: Binary indicator for presence of temporal constraint markers.
feature_definitions.quantity_scarcity_cues: Frequency of stock/inventory and scarcity markers (left, stock, remaining, only, sold, claimed).
feature_definitions.comparative_price_cues: Frequency of comparative pricing/discount cues (save, off, was, regular, discount, best, deal).
feature_definitions.social_reference_cues: Frequency of crowd/social activity markers (people, viewed, bought, others, purchased, customers, demand).
feature_definitions.digit_token_ratio: Proportion of tokens containing digits or numerical quantities.
feature_definitions.has_currency_or_percent: Binary indicator for presence of currency symbols ($, £, €) or percentage signs (%).
